ActorTalk: Kuroro #7721... went MIA in the Fog incident... he's marked as "permanently offline" in the database...
Abnormal fluctuations detected in your emotion module. Energy consumption increased by 17%.
He was my best... friend... We carried out 3346 patrol missions together...
Are you hungry? I can cook something for you.
...We're robots. We don't need to eat.
But humans eat when they're sad. I actually have 127 cooking tutorials...
